stages.description: Master the board, piece movements, special moves, and checkmate conditions.
Learn center control, rapid piece development, and essential opening systems.
Sharpen pattern recognition, tactical combinations, and positional planning.
Convert advantages, calculate variations, and build a long-term improvement regimen.

chapters.title: Chess Basics
chapters.description: Understanding the battlefield, army composition, relative values, and notation.

chapters.title: Piece Movements
chapters.description: Detailed movement mechanics, capture rules, and unique strengths of all 6 pieces.

chapters.title: Special Moves
chapters.description: The 3 special rules that every chess player must know: Castling, En Passant, and Promotion.

chapters.title: Check & Checkmate
chapters.description: The win conditions, check escape techniques, and the critical difference between Checkmate and Stalemate.

chapters.title: Opening Principles
chapters.description: The fundamental rules of the opening: center control, piece development, king safety, and avoiding early blunders.

chapters.title: Essential Openings
chapters.description: The most important classical opening systems for White and Black.

chapters.title: Chess Tactics
chapters.description: The tactical toolkit of champions: Forks, Pins, Skewers, Discovered Attacks, and Back Rank weaknesses.

chapters.title: Strategic Thinking
chapters.description: Positional mastery: Pawn structures, piece activity, open files, weak squares, and space advantages.

chapters.title: Middlegame
chapters.description: The heart of chess battle: Formulating plans, calculating exchanges, king attacks, and positional maneuvers.

chapters.title: Endgame Fundamentals
chapters.description: The technical phase where pawns queen and precise King activity decides the victor.

chapters.title: Calculation & Visualization
chapters.description: Developing a Grandmaster mind: Candidate moves, deep variations, and board visualization.

chapters.title: Practical Chess
chapters.description: Over-the-board psychological skills: Clock management, blunder checks, and systematic game reviews.

chapters.title: Advanced Chess
chapters.description: Master-level concepts: Positional sacrifices, opening preparation, and deep endgame technique.

chapters.title: Chess Improvement
chapters.description: The structured daily training regimen to reach master strength.
